evidence.quote: We're switching from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB

observations.why: Present-continuous framing of a planned migration directs attention forward to a concrete, not-yet-accomplished system change.
Arrow notation encodes a concrete planned transition, not a current state — attention is on the future migration.
Performance gain stated as a settled attribute of the migration — present attention on an abstract quantitative claim.
A specific future date anchors attention on a concrete planned milestone not yet realized.
